name: scroll_compressor_reed_valve
title: Scroll compressor with discharge (reed) valve - reference model
summary: Semi-empirical hermetic scroll compressor extending Winandy et al. (2002) with a discharge (reed) valve and a clearance volume: choked leakage and discharge-valve flows fix the mass flow rate; parameters identified on a Copeland ZH15K4E-TFD catalogue (R407C); reduced evaporator/condenser close the cycle.

authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002)

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of the source file (121 common variables): derived results agree within 1.1e-3 (isentropic efficiency), 1.8e-2 (pressures), 3.1e-2 (mass flow) and 5.3e-2 (duties); absolute h/s/u differ by the EES/CoolProp R407C reference-state offset (about 143 kJ/kg and 763 J/kg-K).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (last run: t_ev = 10 °C, t_cd = 50 °C, R407C)
verification.notes: Maximum rel. diff 5.25e-1 on absolute enthalpies (reference-state offset between the two R407C property backends, does not affect the physics); derived quantities within 5.3e-2, worst small-difference quantities (mixture c_p, heating-up ΔT) 12-13 %. Same property-backend behaviour as CSL-0078.
